scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n contracts,api,web,admin 'npm run dev -w @qrgenerator/contracts' 'npm run dev -w @qrgenerator/api' 'npm run dev -w @qrgenerator/web' 'npm run dev -w @qrgenerator/admin'
scripts.build: npm run build -w @qrgenerator/contracts && npm run build -w @qrgenerator/api && npm run build -w @qrgenerator/web && npm run build -w @qrgenerator/admin
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @qrgenerator/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
